about: Curated link lists and catalogs (awesome-*), prompt galleries, resource collections. The main content of the repo is a list of other things.
Tutorials, courses, books, roadmaps, how-to guides, interview prep, cookbooks and example repos meant for learning.
Mail servers, email clients, email sending APIs and libraries, email templates and editors, SMTP testing, notification infrastructure, email for agents.
Tools, skills and agents that generate or edit video using AI models or coding agents: HyperFrames, Remotion skills, Seedance, text-to-video, agent-driven video editors.
Conventional video software: editors, screen recorders, streaming, players, ffmpeg tools, subtitles, video analysis.
Text-to-speech, speech recognition, voice cloning, audio processing, music generation, MIDI and music programming.
Image generation models and apps, image editing, ASCII art, logo and illustration generation.
Parsing or converting documents (PDF, Office, Markdown), OCR, slide and presentation tools, office suites.
three.js, WebGL, WebGPU, shaders, 3D model generation, gaussian splatting, physics engines, 3D web demos.
2D animation libraries, motion design, canvas libraries, SVG tools, diagrams and whiteboards, scroll effects.
Security scanners, pentesting and red teaming, authentication and identity, encryption, guardrails and sandboxes that keep AI agents safe, governance and policy.
Microcontrollers, e-paper displays, robots, drones, IoT protocols, CAD, smart home hardware.
Trading, stock data, payments, invoicing, billing, ERP, CRM, e-commerce.
Persistent memory layers for AI agents, knowledge graphs built to give agents context.
Retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, knowledge bases, AI search engines.
Code review tools and bots, static analysis, code indexing and search, codebase understanding, test verification.
Browser automation, web scraping and crawling, computer-use agents, turning web pages into data for agents.
MCP servers, MCP SDKs and gateways, platforms that connect agents to external tools.
Agent skills and plugins that improve design, UI, UX or visual taste of what the agent builds.
Agent skills for research, writing, marketing, product management, sales, science, journalism.
Large multi-domain skill packs, official vendor skill repos, registries, plugin marketplaces, skill managers.
Agent skills and plugins for software engineering practice: planning, debugging, verification, discipline, agent behavior.
System prompts, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files, spec-driven development, context compression and token saving.
Running and coordinating many agents: orchestrators, agent teams, task boards for agents, workspaces managing parallel agents.
Coding agents, harnesses, IDE agents, AI app builders, usage monitors and companions for coding agents.
Tracing and monitoring for LLMs and agents, evaluation frameworks, benchmarks.
Running models locally, inference engines, open LLM weight releases, fine-tuning tools.
LLM API gateways, routers, proxies, API key management.

Chat interfaces, end-user LLM apps, chat UI component libraries.

Databases, ORMs, database management tools, data pipelines.

Note taking, task and project management, time tracking, personal productivity apps.

Desktop app frameworks, native mobile or desktop apps and libraries, browser extensions.
